integrity: The face classification and homotopy proof are explicit. Independent finite graph-connectivity checks are corroborative and not treated as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only geometric fixed spaces of the full cyclic or full dihedral group are classified, for n>=4. An overlapping formulation in an uninspected 2008 book chapter cannot be excluded; no external mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Arithmetic homotopy of rotationally fixed non-three-connected graph complexes
